notes:
Account: regulated fintech. Primary ask: Private VPC deployment with strict EU-only data residency. Wants full audit logging forwarded to their Splunk instance and CMK in their AWS account (AWS KMS cross-account). Initial target workload: customer-support chat + document search across contract archives (reranking for relevance). Latency SLO: 95p < 150ms token generation for chat (short turns). Throughput: peak 200 concurrent users, ~120 tokens/sec sustained. Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay premium for isolation and residency. Model preference: open large models (quantized Llama2 variants) but needs fallback to smaller LLMs under load.

Security asks: SSO via SAML (Okta), audit logs (audit events for model version, prompts, token counts) shipped to their SIEM, keystore integration with HSM-backed KMS, retention controls (90d default, options to extend). GDPR/data residency: all request metadata and logs must remain in eu-west-1; optional ledger export for audits.

Network/architecture notes: Prefer cross-account VPC peering + AWS NLB in private subnets or AWS PrivateLink for data plane connectivity. They insist on no public IPs on inference instances. Inbound: connections initiated from customer side to Redwood VPC endpoint over TLS (mutual TLS requested but negotiable). Outbound: strict deny list — only to monitoring endpoints (customer-approved) and Redwood control plane (over dedicated peering). Customer will provide firewall rules and will validate ports/ips in staging.

Procurement/legal: needs DPA, addendum for data residency and audit access. Procurement timeline ~4-6 weeks.
